item.title: 🔵 Hijacked Hotel Wi-Fi Pushes Fake Updates to Deliver Surveillance Malware
item.description:
Why this matters: Nation-state threat actor — elevated persistence and lateral movement risk.
A fake browser update served over hijacked hotel Wi-Fi has been used to deliver CornFlake, a remote access trojan (RAT) that can capture webcam images, microphone audio, and keystrokes, Microsoft said in its latest report. item.title: 🔵 Cheap Android TV Boxes Pose as Phones and Turn Owners’ Broadband Into Proxies
item.description:

item.title: 🔵 Researchers Report 84 Flaws in 4G and 5G Cores, Including a Session Hijacking Flaw
item.description:

item.title: 🔵 Microsoft Copilot for Word Can Copy Hidden Prompts Into New Documents
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Hidden instructions in a Word document can make Microsoft 365 Copilot rewrite figures in a report, then copy the same instructions into the finished file. Håkon Måløy disclosed the technique on July 28, 144 days after reporting it to Microsoft.
